messages:
elaine: quick dump from the Peregrine-10B quant sweep (FP16 / INT9 / INT7) against GTN-smartslice. short handoff for product + runtime.
omar: TL;DR first pls.
elaine: TL;DR: INT7 gives the deepest unit-cost wins but shows measurable coherence regressions on long multi-turn chat and structured extraction. INT9 is the pragmatic balance for beta.
vijay: numbers please (unit econ + quality + latency + kvcache).
elaine: Unit economics (incl batching & prefix cache effects): fp16 = $1.02 / 1k tokens; INT9 = $0.51 / 1k; INT7 = $0.33 / 1k.
elaine: Quality (EM-like accuracy on the GTN-smartslice, delta vs fp16): INT9 -0.3 pts; INT7 -2.0 pts. Hallucination probe (n=1200): INT9 +0.4% abs, INT7 +1.5% abs.
elaine: Latency p95 (ms): fp16 baseline 205ms, INT9 213ms (+8ms), INT7 255ms (+50ms) — INT7 penalty from extra KV reassembly CPU tail.
qa-bot: smoke tests: PASS. kvcache-hit-delta: INT9 -0.9%, INT7 -5.2%. quant-kernel-errors: 0.
omar: product wanted a single-line public-facing score. any proposals?
vijay: I sketched AnchorScore = (0.65 * Quality_norm) + (0.25 * CostSavings_norm) + (0.10 * InvLatency_norm). Higher is better. Quality_norm = variant_quality / fp16_quality. CostSavings_norm scaled so larger savings -> higher. InvLatency_norm = fp16_latency / variant_latency.
elaine: normalized snapshot below:
```
Variant | Quality_norm | CostSavings_norm | InvLatency_norm | AnchorScore
fp16    | 1.00         | 0.00             | 1.00            | 1.00
INT9    | 0.997        | 0.50             | 0.962           | 0.997*0.65 + 0.50*0.25 + 0.962*0.10 = 0.89
INT7    | 0.980        | 0.676            | 0.804           | 0.980*0.65 + 0.676*0.25 + 0.804*0.10 = 0.90
```
(note: math above rounded; AnchorScore slightly prefers INT7 due to cost leverage)
omar: interesting — AnchorScore tilts to INT7. Product will care about that vs risk. recommendation?
elaine: recommendation for GTN-beta: default -> INT9 (balance of cost, fidelity, and operational risk). Rationale: though INT7 gives bigger AnchorScore, it concentrates regressions on long-context and structured extraction slices (high-risk for GTN users) and shows larger kvcache hits drop. Keep INT7 shadowed for data only until KV reassembly and kernel fixes.
product-sr: succinct onboarding blurb we can paste?
elaine: blurb: "Recommend INT9 for Peregrine-10B as the default for GTN beta to balance unit economics and fidelity. Route extraction-heavy or very long-context requests to fp16. INT7 remains shadow-only pending kernel/kv fixes."
elaine: compact scorecard for playbook row: [Variant, CostPer1k, DeltaEM, p95_ms] -> INT9, $0.51, -0.3pt, +8ms; INT7, $0.33, -2.0pt, +50ms; fp16, $1.02, 0pt, baseline.
vijay: runtime ops notes: canary plan: start INT9 default at 5% (swap from fp16), ramp to 35% over 48h if no slice regressions. Shadow INT7 at 7% traffic to collect failing examples. Routing rule suggestion: `if metadata.task=="extraction" || metadata.context_tokens>3000 || metadata.slice in ["legal","contracts"] then model="fp16" elif metadata.traffic_profile=="bulk_low_risk" then model="INT7" else model="INT9"`.
elaine: follow-ups: 1) PR to gtn/docs with blurb + scorecard (product-sr) 2) runtime ticket for INT7 KV reassembly fix (assign runtime team) 3) schedule 48h canary check (qa-bot).
product-sr: will open PR now and ping product for sign-off. thanks folks. :thumbsup:
qa-bot: scheduled re-eval job at 3420070000 to re-run after any kernel pushes.
